name: @sand/features
description: Turns sand's features on and off: the Features settings page and the first-run question of what sand is for

sand.label: Features
sand.summary: Turn whole features like Threads, Git or Bots on and off

threads.label: Threads
threads.summary: Work with agents in your project folders, with sub-agents and background jobs

git.label: Git
git.summary: Git status and diffs for each thread's folder

worktrees.label: Worktrees
worktrees.summary: Let a thread work in its own folder and branch

merge.label: Merge
merge.summary: See which threads have work ready to merge, and merge it into the project on this PC

threads-mcp.label: Threads for outside agents
threads-mcp.summary: Outside agents start, message and read threads and manage projects over MCP

bots.label: Bots
bots.summary: Assistants with their own job, memory and model that you chat with

routines.label: Routines
routines.summary: Bots remind you and do things on a schedule

bot-watches.label: Bot watches
bot-watches.summary: Bots listen to pages, folders, webhooks and repos, and wake only when something changed

bots-mcp.label: Bot tools
bots-mcp.summary: Your threads, your bots and outside agents message, read and update your bots over MCP

bridge.label: Bots and threads
bridge.summary: Threads ask your bots, and bots start and message threads

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.summary: Your calendars in one place, for you and your agents

calendar-accounts.label: Calendar accounts
calendar-accounts.summary: Google, Microsoft, CalDAV and subscribed calendars

computers.label: Computer use
computers.summary: Let agents see and use a browser or this PC

browser.label: Browser
browser.summary: A Chrome or Edge browser agents can use, visible or headless

desktop.label: This PC's screen
desktop.summary: Agents see this PC's screen and use its mouse and keyboard

pcs.label: Several PCs & phone
pcs.summary: Use sand from your phone and your other PCs

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.summary: Tell you when something finishes, fails or needs you

mcp-server.label: MCP server
mcp-server.summary: Outside agents reach sand over MCP

updates.label: Updates
updates.summary: Install newer sand releases on every PC

models.label: Models
models.summary: Sign in to AI providers and pick models

engine.label: Agent engine
engine.summary: Runs agent turns: model replies, tool calls and the system prompt

compaction.label: Compaction
compaction.summary: Summarizes a long conversation before its context fills up
compaction.stops: Long conversations stop when their context fills up instead of being summarized.

watch.label: Folder watching
watch.summary: Notices changes in folders for other parts

background.label: Background model
background.summary: A model for titles, summaries and commit messages
background.stops: Titles, summaries and commit messages are no longer written for you.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.summary: Files and images attached to messages, and copying files between PCs
attachments.stops: You can't attach files or images to messages.

file-tools.label: File tools
file-tools.summary: Agents read, write, edit and search files
file-tools.stops: Agents can't read, write or search files.

web-tools.label: Web tools
web-tools.summary: Agents search the web and read pages
web-tools.stops: Agents can't search the web or read pages.

logins.label: Saved logins
logins.summary: Agents sign in and use keys you saved, without seeing them
logins.stops: Agents can't use your saved logins or ask you for passwords and keys.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.summary: How conversations show: messages, pages and the work behind them

composer.label: Composer
composer.summary: Where you write messages: completions, commands, attachments and drafts

html.label: HTML pages
html.summary: Charts, tables and mockups agents show inline in the chat
html.stops: Agents can't show pages in the chat.

approvals.label: Approvals
approvals.summary: Asks you before agents act, with an Inbox of what waits on you
approvals.stops: Agents stop asking before they act; the Inbox empties.

schedules.label: Schedules
schedules.summary: Runs things at set times, even after a restart

watches.label: Watches
watches.summary: Notices when something you follow changes, without spending tokens to check

connections.label: Connections
connections.summary: Accounts of outside services, like Google or Microsoft

usage.label: Usage
usage.stops: Plan limits, cost and tokens are no longer shown.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.summary: Find things and run actions from the keyboard
palette.stops: The command palette and its actions go away.

picker.label: Pickers
picker.summary: Lists and boxes for choosing, renaming and confirming
picker.stops: Boxes for choosing, renaming and confirming go away.

mcp.label: MCP tools
mcp.summary: Tools from your own MCP servers
mcp.stops: Agents lose the tools from your own MCP servers.

extend.label: Plugin writing
extend.summary: Agents list plugins and write new ones
extend.stops: Agents can't list plugins or write new ones.
